item_name: Rothco GI Style Stainless Steel Canteen
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Stainless Steel Canteen is the perfect companion for your outdoor adventures, offering durability and convenience in a sleek, easy-to-carry design. With a 1.3-quart capacity, this canteen provides plenty of water for hikes, camping trips, or any on-the-go activities. The sturdy stainless steel construction ensures long-lasting use, while the screw-off cap with an attached chain ensures the cap stays securely connected to the canteen, making it perfect for outdoor use.
description: Rothco’s Stainless Steel Canteen is the perfect companion for your outdoor adventures, offering durability and convenience in a sleek, easy-to-carry design. With a 1.3-quart capacity, this canteen provides plenty of water for hikes, camping trips, or any on-the-go activities. The sturdy stainless steel construction ensures long-lasting use, while the screw-off cap with an attached chain ensures the cap stays securely connected to the canteen, making it perfect for outdoor use. The canteen is also compatible with Rothco’s stainless steel cup, offering additional versatility. Whether you're exploring the wilderness or just spending time outdoors, this canteen is designed to keep you hydrated and ready for any adventure.
